item_name: Rothco Polarshield Sleeping Bag Style Survival Blanket
item_short_desc: Rothco's Emergency Polarshield Sleeping Bag is the perfect survival blanket that you can take anywhere!
description: Rothco's Emergency Polarshield Sleeping Bag is the perfect survival blanket that you can take anywhere! The ultralight survival blanket that can be used as a sleeping bag, which is also known as a bivvy or bivouac sack. Rothco's survival blanket reflects 90% of your body heat to keep you warm. This emergency blanket fits easily into your backpack and is ideal for a Bug Out Bag or for your next camping or hiking trip. Rothco's Polarshield Survival sleep bag measures 36"x 84".
